theme: An open Friday in St. Pete, your last weekend with the girls before Sunday's handoff.
greeting: Your calendar is clear today, Dan, with no meetings to answer to. The girls are with you and Mike through Sunday and Toronto is next Thursday, so this open stretch is the moment for the panel prep and the two bookings that keep sliding.

needsAttention.title: Pull your ICGN run of show together
needsAttention.detail: You moderate Plenary 7 on stewardship data in Toronto next Thursday, Nov 5. You've approved Jen's reshaped question flow and Flo has it worked in with Rachit, so the open piece is merging it with your own open and bridge into one final run of show before you travel.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out. The p1 task has sat since mid-September; a refundable hold costs nothing and removes the risk.

needsAttention.title: December break destination undecided
needsAttention.detail: Three weeks with all four girls, Dec 13 to Jan 2, and the Oct 15 book-by date has passed. Holiday inventory for six is the thinnest of the year, so pick domestic-or-international and book refundable this week.

flagged.title: Toronto speaker logistics are in
flagged.detail: ICGN sent final details: Plenary 7 at 15:05 Thursday Nov 5, arrive 30 minutes early for the AV desk. Your run of show with Rachit, Jane and Andy stands approved.

flagged.title: NACD New England, Maine team threads
flagged.detail: Group notes on the Maine team and its next event are moving in your inbox, worth a skim for board-network reach while you're searching.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos, NYT Cooking, Monocle and Folio Society, plus sailing and travel deals.
inbox.clear: Nothing else in the inbox is waiting on your reply.

resolved.title: Toronto panel questions locked
resolved.detail: You approved Jen's reshaped question set Wednesday night; Flo confirmed Thursday that Rachit's commercial angle is now worked in.

resolved.title: Comp Toronto ticket in motion
resolved.detail: Jen confirmed she's sorting your free conference place with the ICGN office, nothing for you to chase.

recipe.title: Warm beet soup
recipe.why: Autumn's roots and squash are at their peak right now.

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar to answer to, the clearest run at the bookings that keep getting deferred.
The open stretch holds, a quiet window to draft your Toronto open while the questions are fresh.
Halloween weekend with the girls in St. Pete, your last stretch before Sunday's handoff to Jen.
